accounting.rationale: PDF133 defines VALUE by its argument-association category and directs to the ordinary-dummy rules.15.5.2.4p4/p6,15.5.2.5 and7.5.8 own the anonymous effective object's initial value, component values and ordinary argument conditions. No duplicate local copy-effect S requirement or no-op declaration execution is created. The finite directed plans below remain source/mechanism gates, not coverage.

VALUE is not an INTENT spelling or a universal bitwise-by-value calling convention.8.2/R802 and8.6.16/R864 own specification routes, and15.3.2.2 treats the attribute as a dummy-data characteristic. No existing witness is retagged or automatically linked.

PENDING canonical15.5.2.4p4/p6 run/effect parents with complete internal interfaces: a defined INTEGER actual7 and an independent expression3+4 each initialize a VALUE dummy to7; changing the dummy to19 leaves the caller variable7. Require independent visit/return/completion events. The effective argument is the definable anonymous object, not the original actual. INTENT(IN), if present, separately prevents defining the dummy. Undefined input is not made safe by copying; any undefined-data branch needs an explicit context-only/source plan without reading it or demanding a trap.

PENDING separate canonical parents for a non-BIND fixed-size INTEGER array, equal-length default CHARACTER 'ABC' changed locally to 'XYZ', and a simple fully defined derived object. Distinct whole-actual and expression cases use literal caller-preservation oracles, not bytes or descriptor comparison.7.5.8 distinguishes pointer-component association from allocatable-component allocation/type/parameters/bounds/value and ordinary component values. A defined associated pointer component can still designate shared external data; VALUE is not universal isolation of all pointees. Allocatable-component copying needs its canonical semantics, not an invented shallow copy, allocation order or defined-assignment callback count.

PENDING exact source/use relations to15.5.2.5 type/kind/rank/character rules,15.5.2.13 presence,15.5.2.14 aliasing and19.5/19.6 state. A TARGET+VALUE dummy's escaped pointers become undefined at return under15.5.2.5p12, not false ASSOCIATED or a retained address; keep this context-only at its owner. Non-BIND OPTIONAL+VALUE is not globally prohibited, but absent dummy data are never used. C1568 separately excludes array VALUE dummies for BIND procedures;18.3.7 governs the actual C prototype relationship. No actual argument lacking TARGET is reclassified as a pointer-dummy effective argument.

Use7.5.1p5's potential-subobject definition, not ultimate components or pointer traversal. C751 requires an actual coarray component to be allocatable with deferred coshape. C753 separately requires a component whose type has a coarray potential subobject component to be a nonpointer nonallocatable scalar and not itself a coarray; the general recursive definition does not legalize forbidden component declarations.
The BIND premise belongs to the procedure, not a BIND(C) declaration of a data variable.

requirements.title: VALUE requires a dummy data object and excludes three object categories
requirements.definition: A VALUE entity is a dummy data object, not an assumed-size array or coarray and not a variable with a coarray potential subobject component. These are declaration/category conditions, not a ban on every array or every derived-type component. Assumed-type, assumed-rank and interoperable procedure rules impose their own additional restrictions.

pending.ordinary-data-dummy-admission: PENDING complete non-BIND ordinary INTEGER scalar and fixed-size array dummy declarations with VALUE, and separately typed CHARACTER/simple-derived controls under matching interface/type/length rules. Share actual minimal repaired controls within this constraint family instead of generating no-op supplementary programs. These compile/positive-controls do not prove VALUE's canonical runtime copy behavior.
pending.nondummy-exclusion: PENDING a complete external subroutine with an empty dummy list and INTEGER, VALUE :: subject, no initialization or body use. Repair only the header by adding subject. Require the full VALUE/nondummy-data role cause at legitimate staged header/declaration origins. Existing C851 OPTIONAL controls are different predicates and retain their IDs, attributes and evidence roles.
pending.dummy-procedure-exclusion: PENDING a complete subroutine whose callback dummy is declared through a preceding abstract subroutine interface and PROCEDURE(signature), with VALUE specified separately by a VALUE statement. Remove only that VALUE statement for the ordinary nonpointer dummy-procedure control. Do not insert VALUE in a PROCEDURE attribute list where it is not grammar-admitted. Any additional declaration-role conflict remains a source/cause gate rather than an isolated C867 claim.
pending.assumed-size-exclusion: PENDING a complete non-BIND subroutine s(x) declaring INTEGER, VALUE :: x(*), with no whole-array inquiry or body read. Removing only VALUE gives a valid assumed-size dummy control; retain the same header and shape. Require the VALUE/assumed-size cause, not an unsupported array feature, unavailable size or caller mismatch.
pending.coarray-exclusion: PENDING a complete non-BIND subroutine with ordinary INTEGER, VALUE :: x[*], repaired only by removing VALUE. The scalar coarray dummy and explicit-interface context must otherwise be valid. Compiler/coarray configuration is an explicit capability gate for this witness; an unsupported coarray configuration is not the required VALUE/coarray report. No allocation, images, C interoperability or runtime observation is needed.
pending.coarray-potential-subobject-exclusion: PENDING complete direct and nested nonpointer type definitions containing an INTEGER ALLOCATABLE coarray component with deferred coshape, with a VALUE dummy of that type and no allocation or data use. Repair only by removing VALUE. Trace7.5.1p5 through a nonpointer nonallocatable scalar enclosing component: C753 requires that form when its type has a coarray potential subobject component and excludes an allocatable, pointer, array or coarray enclosing component. Do not substitute ultimate components or invent an otherwise-invalid pointer-barrier control. C751/C753 and actual coarray capability must be resolved before credit for the full VALUE/coarray-potential-subobject cause.
pending.additional-category-source: PENDING role-preserving source relations to C714's assumed-type VALUE exclusion, C839's assumed-rank VALUE exclusion and C1568's BIND-array VALUE exclusion. C714_invalid__value and C714_valid__value_repair remain canonical at tests/fixtures/type_compatibility_c714_value and type_compatibility_c714_value_repair; no copies or metadata promotion. This local constraint does not absorb those separate owners or imply every non-assumed-size array is legal in every context.

requirements.oracle: Complete dummy-category contexts with one-role/attribute repairs, valid controls and exact constraint-specific causes. Potential-subobject traversal is source-defined, not inferred from current allocation or compiler acceptance.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No generic argument, array or coarray substring credit. Reporting capability does not mandate fatal exit, English wording or code C867. Genuine located full causes must be independently qualified; wrong-source/echo/quoted/example/unsupported/Internal/ASR/verifier/resource/crash output does not qualify. No current fixtures, probes, profiles or approvals are added.

requirements.title: VALUE excludes allocation, pointer, output-intent and volatility attributes
requirements.definition: A VALUE entity has none of ALLOCATABLE, POINTER, VOLATILE, INTENT(OUT) or INTENT(INOUT). The restriction is on that dummy entity: pointer or allocatable components and corresponding actual-argument attributes are not automatically the same predicate. INTENT(IN), absence of INTENT, and TARGET are not excluded by this list, but retain all other rules.

pending.allocatable-exclusion: PENDING a complete explicit-interface non-BIND subroutine with scalar INTEGER, ALLOCATABLE, VALUE :: x and no allocation or use. Remove only VALUE for the scalar allocatable dummy control. Require the exact same-dummy VALUE/ALLOCATABLE conflict; an unallocated actual or unsupported allocatable implementation cannot supply it.
pending.pointer-exclusion: PENDING a complete non-BIND subroutine with scalar INTEGER, POINTER, VALUE :: x, no pointer initialization or body use. Remove only VALUE for the pointer-dummy control. No association-status inquiry is made, and no nonpointer actual or INTENT(IN) pointer-target exception is used to repair the declaration.
pending.intent-out-exclusion: PENDING a complete ordinary INTEGER, VALUE, INTENT(OUT) dummy declaration, repaired only by removing VALUE while retaining the empty body and interface. This diagnoses an attribute incompatibility, not OUT entry undefinedness; no undefined dummy or actual value is sampled.
pending.intent-inout-exclusion: PENDING the separately qualified INTEGER, VALUE, INTENT(INOUT) contrast, repaired only by removing VALUE. Keep a complete dummy/interface context and no caller-dependent definability defect. OUT and INOUT are distinct source alternatives and need their own causal report, not a generic INTENT message.
pending.volatile-exclusion: PENDING a complete scalar INTEGER, VALUE, VOLATILE dummy contrast, repaired only by removing VALUE. Restrict the planned case to this declaration incompatibility; standalone VOLATILE semantics and effects belong to their own owner and are not authored here. Unsupported language-feature messages do not count.
pending.intent-in-and-no-intent-controls: PENDING complete VALUE scalar controls with INTENT(IN) and with no INTENT, sharing qualified minimal-control context where possible. A body definition of the IN dummy would be C846/8.5.10, not evidence that VALUE is forbidden. Canonical runtime isolation may mutate only the no-INTENT anonymous effective object after its defined initial value is established.
pending.entity-versus-component-and-actual-sourc: PENDING 7.5.8 and15.5.2.4/.5/.13 relations for a VALUE derived dummy with legal pointer or allocatable components and for a defined associated pointer or allocated allocatable actual passed to an ordinary VALUE dummy. The dummy itself has neither prohibited attribute. Preserve matching type/kind, actual availability and presence; component associations can still reach shared targets. No arbitrary bitwise copy, unallocated/disassociated read, assumed kind/storage width or ABI model.

requirements.oracle: Five independent same-dummy attribute contradictions with complete single-VALUE-removal controls, plus lawful IN/no-INTENT and component/actual boundaries. Canonical INTENT and value-initialization effects retain their owners.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No required fatal rejection, particular status/code/English or generic attribute-token evidence. Actual source predicates and origins must be isolated; unsupported facilities, unrelated type or state defects, echoes, wrong-source recovery and compiler failures never qualify. Mandatory runtime behavior is not replaced by these compile controls.

requirements.title: A BIND procedure dummy cannot combine OPTIONAL and VALUE
requirements.definition: When a procedure has BIND, none of its dummy arguments has both OPTIONAL and VALUE. The conjunction is conditional on the procedure's attribute: it neither bans each attribute separately for all interoperable dummies nor prohibits the combination in every non-BIND procedure. Interoperability, type, rank, characteristics and presence have separate canonical conditions.

pending.bind-optional-value-exclusion: PENDING a complete module procedure s(x) BIND(C), importing INTEGER(C_INT) from ISO_C_BINDING and declaring scalar x OPTIONAL and VALUE, with no initialization, call or body access. A single removal of OPTIONAL produces a VALUE control; separately, removing VALUE produces an OPTIONAL control. Keep the same interoperable scalar type and procedure BIND premise, and require the full three-way BIND/OPTIONAL/VALUE cause. No guessed kind number, array/character complication or C linking failure.
pending.single-attribute-controls: PENDING source-qualified compile/positive-controls for the two single-attribute repairs of that same complete scalar module procedure. C1563/C1565 and18.3.5/.7 must establish interoperability independently. Do not create duplicate empty programs for the two constraint facets or infer a C ABI observation from a Fortran-only compile.
pending.nonbind-combination-control: PENDING the same scalar OPTIONAL+VALUE declaration in a complete ordinary non-BIND procedure, with removal of only the procedure BIND specification from the invalid context. The dummy remains an eligible data object. Any later omission runtime plan is owned by OPTIONAL/argument-presence semantics and must guard data access with PRESENT control flow; absence of the BIND premise is not permission to read an absent dummy.
pending.interop-and-presence-source: PENDING canonical18.3.7p2(4)-(7)/p7 and15.6.2.1 C1563-C1568 source relations, preserving scalar VALUE-to-C-value correspondence versus non-VALUE pointer/descriptor forms and the optional-absence null-pointer rule. A genuine C companion, actual supported interoperable kinds and matching prototype are required before C runtime evidence. None is executed or approved here, and general VALUE is not a universal byte-copy ABI.

requirements.oracle: One complete interoperable scalar declaration contrast with three single-premise controls and precise BIND/OPTIONAL/VALUE causal reporting. Cross-language runtime and optional presence retain their respective source and evidence owners.
requirements.oracle_limitation: C869 requires diagnostic capability, not a linker error, fatal exit, exact English or a code. Generic OPTIONAL, VALUE, BIND or argument strings do not establish the conjunction. No unsupported C binding, wrong interface, invalid kind, source echo or compiler-failure credit. The committed C851 ordinary dummy eligibility cases are unchanged and are not C869 witnesses.

review_rationale: Independent complete original4base/21fine VALUE source and18pending-facet review7badc6f348dce4d86f7ae6a15f9da3af566fa4084ee54e83054b83e1bf62df96, registered in doc/source_audits/batch_064.json. P1defines argument association while15.5.2.4p4/p6 owns the anonymous effective object, so no duplicate local copy-effect S requirement is created. C867 preserves potential-subobject rather than ultimate-component semantics and valid C751/C753 enclosing forms. C868 applies five exclusions to the dummy itself, not its components or actual. C869's procedure-BIND and jointOPTIONAL/VALUE premises retain interoperable scalar, array and presence gates. Derived value copying is not a universal deep-isolation, bit-copy, address or ABI promise.
